preToolUse.powershell: try { $py=(Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; $s="$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\statelessness_guard.py"; if ($py -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $py $s } } catch {}; exit 0
preToolUse.bash: s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/statelessness_guard.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then python3 "$s" || true; fi; exit 0
